data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that curves text in place based on a given curvature value.
data.what_it_does: It creates curved text in the center of the space defined by the parent's constraints using a specified curvature and optional text style. It allows text to curve up and down around a fixed point.
use_when: You need to display text along a curved path in your Flutter UI.
You want to curve text in place without manually calculating a large virtual circle.
avoid_when: You need complex multi-line text layouts or advanced typography engines.
You are looking for general state management or navigation features.
strengths: Simple API requiring only curvature, text, and an optional text style.
Curves text in place within the parent's constraints.
weaknesses: Limited feature set focused strictly on single-string curved text.
